title: OsmSignalTile
description: One bundled signal tile, public/seed/osm-signals/<tileId>.json, and the shape held in the device cache (src/providers/osm/adapter.ts). Every OpenStreetMap node tagged highway=traffic_signals that RouteIQ counts, in one 0.1 degree tile. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

tileId.description: <x>_<y>: the tile's west and south edges in tenths of a degree (src/core/tiles.ts).

fetchedAt.description: How current the data is, milliseconds since 1970: for a bundled tile the date of the extract it was built from.

nodes.description: Empty for a tile with no signals.
